imd.title: IMD extended range forecast (weekly press release), 15 October 2026: current weather status and extended range forecast for the next two weeks (15 to 28 October 2026)
imd.summary: North-east monsoon rain began on 15 October over Tamil Nadu, Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Rayalaseema, with fairly widespread to widespread rain likely over Tamil Nadu (15–19 October) and Rayalaseema (16–20 October), and isolated very heavy rain over Tamil Nadu on 15–16 October. For 22–28 October IMD expects scattered to fairly widespread rain over most of Peninsular India and above-normal rainfall over south Peninsular India.

weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.text: North-east monsoon rain commenced on 15 October over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Karaikal, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Rayalaseema, South Interior Karnataka and Kerala, as the south-west monsoon withdrew from the entire country. Fairly widespread to widespread rainfall likely over Tamil Nadu (15–19 October), Rayalaseema (16–20 October) and Coastal Andhra Pradesh (18–20 October); isolated heavy rain over Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Rayalaseema on 15–16 October and over Tamil Nadu on 17–21 October, with isolated very heavy rain over Tamil Nadu on 15–16 October. Rainfall for the country as a whole is likely to be below normal; no category is given for South Peninsular India.

regional_text.Rayalaseema: Fairly widespread to widespread rainfall likely during 16–20 October, with isolated heavy rain on 15–16 October, strong surface winds on 15–19 October and thunderstorms with gusty winds on 16–19 October.
regional_text.Tamil Nadu: Fairly widespread to widespread rainfall likely during 15–19 October, with isolated very heavy rain on 15–16 October, isolated heavy rain on 17–21 October and thunderstorms with gusty winds on 15–19 October.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.text: A trough is likely to extend from the south-west Arabian Sea to the south-east Bay of Bengal across Kerala and Tamil Nadu on some days. Scattered to fairly widespread rainfall likely over most parts of Peninsular India and along the east coast, with isolated heavy rain over Tamil Nadu, Kerala and South Interior Karnataka on many days and over Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Rayalaseema on a few days. Rainfall likely to be above normal over south Peninsular India.

regional_text.Rayalaseema: Isolated heavy rainfall likely on a few days of the week; scattered to fairly widespread rain over most of Peninsular India and above-normal rainfall expected over south Peninsular India.
regional_text.Tamil Nadu: Isolated heavy rainfall likely on many days of the week, with a trough across Tamil Nadu on some days; above-normal rainfall expected over south Peninsular India.

season.text: October–December (north-east monsoon) rainfall over South Peninsular India is most likely normal (88–112% of the long-period average). October rainfall is likely below normal for India as a whole, but normal to above normal over southern parts of the peninsula. Strong El Niño conditions are expected to strengthen to the end of the year; the Indian Ocean Dipole is neutral.
